description: From the Puente de San Pablo the Casas Colgadas seem to float over the black Huécar gorge — three medieval houses with their famous wooden balconies clinging to the cliff face, their warm interior lights glowing against the night. The red iron bridge arcs across the gorge in the foreground, and the canyon walls fall away into darkness below. Visitors describe crossing the bridge at night as magical, when the illuminated houses hang above the void like lanterns.

The red metal bridge spans the gorge in the foreground. Dark canyon walls and the Huécar river below. No identifiable people prominent. Subject centred so it survives a 4:5 centre crop.
